caption: The drawing shows two primary elements against a beige background. At the top, there is a horizontally oriented, rectangular illustration in monochrome; it features a horse-drawn carriage with two horses and several human figures, some of whom appear to be running or engaged in energetic activity near the carriage, with trees or foliage implied in the background. Below this scene, positioned centrally, is a detailed illustration of a small, metallic revolver with a brown wooden grip. The revolver is oriented with its barrel pointed to the right, and engraved scenes or patterns are visible on the metal component above the trigger. The artist's signature, "ROSE CAMPBELL," appears in small, neat text below and to the right of the revolver. The entire composition is centered on the page, with ample blank space surrounding both objects.
title: Revolver
